notes.title: Call for Early Testing of Version 1.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

First, we apologize for not providing any updates since our last announcement about version 0.9.0.

After careful consideration about this version, which has many elements closely connected to version 1.0, we decided to cancel this release and include everything in version 1.0.0 to give players the most complete experience possible.

And the time for version 1.0.0 is coming very soon!

[b]Currently, we have uploaded this version to a separate test branch available for all users who own the game to download at any time.[/b]

With limited resources and many challenges as shared in previous announcements, [b]we call on and hope you will help us by playing this early version to provide feedback about bugs or issues you encounter[/b], so we can perfect the game before its official release at the end of this month!

[b]The test version will be available from the moment you see this post until April 25, 2025.[/b]

[list]
[*] How to participate in testing: switch your game branch to the test branch following the instructions at the end of this post.
[*] How to report bugs/issues: comment directly on this post or contact us via [url=https://discord.com/invite/UkPAPmHQ32]Discord[/url]
[*] We sincerely thank you and wish you happy gaming!
[/list]

[h2]FAQ:[/h2]

[h3]Q: Can I test the game using my current save file?[/h3]
A: Absolutely, however we cannot fully guarantee save file compatibility, which may lead to unforeseen issues during gameplay. We will also announce this when officially launching.
If you still use your old save file to play and encounter problems, please report it as a bug and contact us for support if you cannot continue playing.

[h3]Q: Can I continue using my save file from this test version when the official release launches?[/h3]
A: Yes, this test version is fully compatible with the official release, so you can continue without having to start over.

[h3]Q: Will this be the final official release version?[/h3]
A: No, we're still completing some final tasks to create a polished version. We will continuously update this test branch with changes and bug fixes until the official release date.

[h3]Q: When is version 1.0 expected to launch?[/h3]
A: We hope everything goes smoothly so we can launch before April 29.

[h3]Q: What specifically is included in this test version and version 1.0?[/h3]
A: We will provide a detailed post about all new content, modifications, and improvements in version 1.0 before the release date.

[h2]Instructions for participating in testing:[/h2]

[h3]Important note:[/h3]
Please backup your current save file before switching to the test branch.
Here is where you can find those files:
<your steam library folder>\steamapps\common\Chill Town\Chill Town_Data\Saves

[h3]Follow these steps to switch branches as shown in the video clip below:[/h3]
https://gyazo.com/25b5da072eb1d9214a4a265a19214d50

- Right click on Chill Town and select Properties...
- Select the beta tab and enter "chilltowntesting" then click Check code
- In the Beta Participation dropdown, select "publictesting"

[h3]How to switch back to the official branch:[/h3] follow the same steps above but without entering a code, open the Beta Participation dropdown and select "None"

notes.title: What is coming next!?
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today, we have lots of new short clips for you to enjoy! 🎥✨
Here's a quick look at some of the features coming in the upcoming 0.9.0 and 1.0.0 update:

[b]1. Sprint Ability[/b]
[previewyoutube=Gs3aFHBULJ8;full][/previewyoutube]
Many users have requested a running option, and since walking at a slow pace was rarely needed, we've removed it. Now, you can sprint at a faster speed by holding Shift—and don’t worry, there’s no stamina limit!

[b]2. Free Placement Mode[/b]
[previewyoutube=ceKbr1xYZuI;full][/previewyoutube]
The complexity and variety of object sizes in the game have made the grid system somewhat inconvenient, especially when placing objects close together or near walls. This new feature will completely resolve those issues!


[b]3. Nature Exhibit (Insects, Plants, Flowers)[/b]
[previewyoutube=K3XZ0Pecd8k;full][/previewyoutube]
The setup is now complete—all that’s left is for you to fill it with your collection! (The museum will be arriving with version 1.0.0.)

[b]4. A Sneak Peek at Festivals[/b]
[previewyoutube=ORXmYvTy27U;full][/previewyoutube]
Here’s a small preview of what you’ll experience during one of the in-game festivals. Spring Festival brings the ability to decorate the Town Square with flowers and bonsai pots. During this time, flowers will also bloom more frequently throughout Chill Town and the surrounding islands! Oh, and don't forget—the festival also comes with exclusive rewards! (The festival will be arriving with version 1.0.0.)

notes.title: Important announcement regarding our current situation and upcoming plans
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42742040/5418989133f381731126ad63f98e72a40c525bc4.png[/img]

Dear players,

First and foremost, we would like to express our sincere gratitude for the support and following from all players. Your companionship has been an invaluable motivation for our development team.

It has been quite a while since our last project progress update, and we have received numerous feedback from backers through negative reviews on Steam. Today, we would like to share some updates to address your concerns and provide you with a more comprehensive overview of the current situation.

[b]Development Progress[/b]
As you may have noticed, we haven't had any updates since August, and our devlogs have been sporadic with limited new information. This is partly due to team members dealing with personal family and health issues that required immediate attention (as mentioned in our May 2024 announcement).

[b]Financial Situation[/b]
Our main challenge currently is financial difficulties. To maintain operations, we have had to diversify our revenue streams through developing and publishing Hot Springs alongside the Peach Party team, as well as updating and launching new DLCs for Chill Corner.

Regarding our Kickstarter campaign, we want to be transparent with our community while respecting our contractual obligations. While the final funding amount is publicly visible on Kickstarter, the actual amount we received was less than half of that figure after accounting for various campaign-related expenses and fees - which were beyond our control. We regret that we cannot disclose the exact details due to confidentiality agreements, but we hope this helps explain why we've had to operate with significantly less resources than what might appear on the surface. With this limited capital, we maintained a team of 8 people (including 4 artists, 1 animator, and 3 developers) until November 2023. After that, we used personal funds to maintain operations until March 2024.

[b]Current Situation and Future Plans[/b]
The Early Access version of Chill Town has sold over 6,000 copies in the past 9 months (counting 15% refund rate). This revenue is only sufficient to maintain basic living expenses and repay previous development loans. Due to declining revenue in the past 4 months, the team currently consists of only 2 developers with no artists.

[b]Official Release Plan[/b]
We plan to launch the Official Release in Q1 2025 with new features:
- Museum System
- New Quest Lines
- Seasonal and Festival System
- Bug Fixes and Gameplay Improvements

Due to the absence of artists, we will combine self-development within our capabilities and use appropriate assets to complete the game.

[b]Project Support[/b]
If you enjoy our project and would like to support us, please help spread the word about the game to more people. This will help us gain more resources to continue development.

[b]French Translation Update[/b]
We have integrated French language support into the game and will update it in an upcoming patch. Special thanks to @kulturegaming and @poudredenuage for their voluntary translation contributions!

Once again, thank you for your patience and support.

Best regards,
Low-Hi Tech

notes.title: Major Update 0.7.0 - Fruit Tree, Auto Farming and more!
notes.content:
Hello Chill Town community! 🌟

After a relatively quiet period, we are thrilled to bring you the latest major update to the game, packed with new content and improvements. Let's dive into the details below:

[b]Fruit Tree 🍊[/b]
[previewyoutube=aWp0wjVQvTQ;full][/previewyoutube]
We've completed the fruit tree feature, allowing you to plant and harvest fruit trees. There are a total of 10 types of fruits in this update. Besides oranges available at the NPC's shop, you will embark on a journey to explore the island, collect various fruits, and bring them back to grow your farm.

To guide you through this content, we’ve added a new quest and dialogue with NPC Mika. If you've completed her tree planting quest, you can start planting oranges, harvest them to trigger related dialogues about fruit trees.

To boost your motivation around this feature, we've added 3 new related achievements.

Please note that this is not the end of this feature. In future updates, we will continue to add new tree species and experiment with improvements like differentiating leaves and canopies for easier identification. We are also considering allowing trees to be dug up and relocated instead of only chopping them down.

Lastly, besides fruit trees, you can now purchase 4 other types of trees—Oak, Maple, Pine, and Birch—to decorate your town.

[b]Auto Farming 🌾[/b]
[previewyoutube=ghRpZzOMocE;full][/previewyoutube]
As introduced from the early days to the community, Chill Town aims to incorporate idle elements. While the initial release only had the Auto Fishing feature, this update brings you Auto Farming. This feature allows you to harvest and water all crops in the town with a single click. We believe it will be very useful, saving you time and letting you do other things while the game performs these tasks automatically.

Currently, this feature occasionally encounters some movement issues. If you experience this, use the Unstuck button to fix it.

[b]Path Tile Rework 🛤️[/b]
[previewyoutube=dWbVsX2DVrE;full][/previewyoutube]
We've revamped all the textures of the path tiles for a more beautiful look. Additionally, we’ve added borders around the tiles, helping you create more attractive and professional pathways.
   
We will continue to add more diverse textures like granite, cobblestone, and decorative tiles in future updates.

[b]Custom Album and Custom Music 🎶[/b]
We’ve introduced a Custom Album feature that allows you to mix songs from the game’s music library to create highly personalized albums based on your preferences instead of playing them in the predefined order.

Additionally, you can now import your own music in ogg and mp3 formats to play directly in the game.

[b]New Music Album 🎵[/b]
If you’re a fan of the background music from Animal Crossing: New Horizons, you might love this new album—Mischievous. It has a playful yet relaxing and gentle vibe.

[b]Feeding Pets 🐾[/b]
[previewyoutube=kLZ0IrRzp8Y;full][/previewyoutube]
You can now feed your pets anytime you want, as long as you have the appropriate food.

[b]Additional Minor Updates 🛠️[/b]
[list]
[*] The number of days in each season has increased from 7 to 10.
[*] We've added interactive dialogues with Rosa and Mika, providing hints on where to find various flowers, crops, and fruits instead of leaving you without any information. If you haven't completed these collections or start a new playthrough, interacting with Rosa and Mika will be very helpful.
[*] In the early stages of the game, if you haven't built a house, time will not progress, ensuring you don’t waste your first day.
[*] Time will now pause when you are interacting with UI elements like opening shop screens or talking to NPCs.
[*] Fixed some minor bugs.
[/list]

Enjoy the update and happy gaming! 🌟

notes.title: Upcoming Free Music Album and Patch Note 0.5.9
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The latest version of Chill Town 0.5.9 has just been updated.
This time, it includes [b]some new features as part of the second milestone on the roadmap[/b], along with the [b]completion of a milestone for the Free Update campaign[/b]. Therefore, we are posting an update rather than just a small patch note.

First of all, thank you for your support over the past 6 days. The game has[b] surpassed 2,000 purchases[/b] to date, so we will proceed to update the game by adding [b]3 new Music Albums, one each week starting from next week[/b]. All players will receive them after the update.

Next, while some team members continue to fix bugs, others have started working on different milestones on the roadmap. Some may not follow the exact order, so as long as there is something new, we will update, and here are the details of this update:
[list]
[*] All path tiles can now be built using the Hammer, eliminating the need to place each Tile in Construction mode as before. This makes it quicker and more convenient for you to build paths. Additionally, these tiles will not appear in construction mode to avoid confusion with the floor. More path tiles will be updated once our artist team completes their work.
[*] Island Sharing: If you play far enough, you'll discover that at Kuku's port, there is a service to travel to other players' islands. This means any player who meets the condition (island from 2 stars upwards) can share their island through the app Town Profile on their phone. This allows other players to find and visit your island.
Please note that this is not a coop or multiplayer feature, so you will not see each other.
[*] If the game's graphics appear blurry to you or you dislike the Depth of Field effect in the game, we have added an option to turn it off in the Display section of Game Settings.
[*] The Date of Birth screen now displays days from 1 to 7 according to the season instead of days in the year (from 1 to 28) as before.
[*] Fixed some bugs that caused insects and Pal not to spawn.
[/list]

notes.title: The Official Roadmap is Here!
notes.content:
Greetings, Chill Town enthusiasts!

We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Chill Town's Early Access program, marking the culmination of two years of dedicated development. We're immensely grateful for your unwavering support in building a welcoming and joyful gaming community that prioritizes relaxation above all else.

As we embark on this exciting journey together, we're eager to share our roadmap for the future of Chill Town:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42742040/c064ca73644b597fd1aac4be0d0f54aae646420b.png[/img]

[h3]1. Early Monitoring:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Ongoing bug fixing and hotfixes: We'll be actively monitoring and addressing critical bugs and performance issues throughout March, ensuring a smooth experience for all players (including on Steam Deck).
[*] Enhanced controller support: Full controller support will be implemented, complete with helpful button hints and icons for a more intuitive gameplay experience.
[*] Steam achievements: We're adding Steam achievements to celebrate your accomplishments and milestones in Chill Town.
[/list]

[h3]2. Nurturing, Decorating, and Building:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Cultivating your own fruit trees: Starting with the humble orange, you'll be able to plant and nurture a variety of fruit trees, fostering a thriving ecosystem on your island.
[*] Crafting pathways: The popular fence-building feature will be expanded to include path creation, allowing you to seamlessly design and customize your island's layout with the same intuitive hammer tool.
[*] Deepening social connections: Two new features will enhance the social aspects of Chill Town:
[*] Island sharing: Share your island with others, allowing them to explore and appreciate your unique creations.
[*] Island visiting: Embark on virtual adventures by visiting other players' islands and discovering their creative visions.
[*] Player markers: A trading system will be implemented, enabling you to exchange decorative items with other players and acquire the perfect pieces for your island.
[/list]

[h3]3. Seasons and Festivities:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Enriching seasonal experiences: We'll be transforming the in-game seasons, imbuing each one with distinct characteristics and captivating objectives to encourage exploration and discovery.
[*] Celebrating with in-game events: Festive cheer will be woven into the fabric of Chill Town through engaging mini-games and special events, offering players exciting seasonal experiences.
[*] Seasonal influence on flora and fauna: The impact of seasons on the game's ecosystem will be deepened, with dynamic changes to flora, fauna, and crops, further enriching the world of Chill Town.
[*] Introducing seasonal items: Each season will feature unique items to be discovered and collected, adding another layer of depth and variety to the game.
[/list]

[h3]4. The Museum:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Showcasing your prized collection: The long-awaited Museum will finally be unveiled, providing a dedicated space to display your cherished collection of artifacts and treasures.
[*] Unveiling new quests and interactions: The Museum will offer engaging quests and interactive elements, further enriching the gameplay experience.
[*] Crafting a captivating environment: The Museum's environment will be meticulously designed to complement the awe-inspiring collection it houses.
[/list]

[h3]5. Expanding Content:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Enriching the ecosystem: New creatures like beetles, unique island ecosystems, Pal variants, and hybrid variations will be introduced, adding to the diversity and vibrancy of the game world.
[*] Welcoming new companions: More exotic pets and a wider variety of cats will be available, allowing you to further personalize your island experience.
[/list]

[h3]6. Preparing for Official Launch:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Continuous refinement: We'll be actively incorporating your feedback and suggestions to polish and refine every aspect of the game, ensuring a polished and satisfying experience for the official launch.
[*] Charting the future together: Once the planned milestones are achieved, we'll work closely with the community to shape the future of Chill Town, crafting new experiences and features that resonate with our dedicated player base.
[/list]

Thank you for your unwavering support. We're excited to embark on this journey with you and look forward to creating a thriving and unforgettable gaming experience in Chill Town.

Sincerely,

The Low-Hi Tech Team
